lede.zh: 不需要任何编程或算法基础。机器人在表上一格一格地算，你接出它每一格跑的电路板，再把拼好的板当元件用。
lede.en: No programming or algorithms background needed. A robot works across a table cell by cell; you wire the board it runs on every cell, then use a finished board as a part.

desc.zh: 把两条来路的数加起来；「起点」口是「是」时，再加 1。
desc.en: Adds up the numbers on its two ways in, plus 1 when its “start” port is “yes”.

desc.zh: 机器人在每一格上运行同一块电路板；拼好的电路板会变成元件。
desc.en: On every cell the robot runs the same circuit board, and a finished board becomes a component.
